Market Intelligence for Government Contracting
Compete with Confidence in the Federal Market

Stepping into the government market means figuring out exactly who needs what you sell and how they prefer to buy it. Sorting through years of complex government data on your own can be a frustrating and time-consuming experience. Market Intelligence takes all of that historical spend and complicated agency structure and turns it into a clear roadmap for your business. We help you see the big picture so you can confidently decide where to focus your time and resources to get your foot in the door.

KNOW THE PLAYERS
Federal Agency & Vendor Entities

To win contracts, you need to understand the landscape of who is involved. The Entities tool helps you map out the exact organizations operating in your space so you can build targeted relationships.

Vendors

Explore the businesses already winning contracts in your field. This is not just about keeping an eye on the competition; it is the perfect way to identify established prime contractors who might be looking for a specialized, capable partner.

Try our vendor search -->
Agencies

It is easy to get lost in massive government departments. We help you bypass the noise and identify the specific agencies that actually have a history of buying your type of product, allowing you to focus your time where it matters most.

Try our agency search -->
Offices

Government purchasing often happens at the local level. Drill down past the main agency to find the specific regional offices and facilities making the actual buying decisions so you know exactly who to contact.

Try our office search -->
TRACK PURCHASING TRENDS
Government Spend Insights

Understanding how the government spends money is the key to predicting future opportunities. This category houses the specific searches you need to view past and present purchasing habits without overwhelming you with spreadsheets.

Awards

Seeing past awards gives you a realistic baseline. You can see exactly who won previous contracts and for how much, taking the guesswork out of how to competitively price your own solutions.

Try our awards search -->
Solicitations

While your Find & Nurture tab focuses on active bids, this tool lets you look at history. Analyzing past solicitations helps you spot seasonal buying trends and cycles, so you can anticipate exactly when an agency is getting ready to purchase.

Try our solicitations search -->
Contracts

Dive into the details of active contracts to understand their scope and expiration dates. This allows you to build a long-term strategy and start preparing for future re-competes well before they are announced.

Try our contracts search -->
Vehicles

Government contract vehicles can sound like a different language. We simplify this by showing you the exact purchasing methods or checkout lanes agencies prefer to use so you know exactly how you need to be positioned to make a seamless sale.

Try our vehicle search -->
Taking Action on Your Research

Market Intelligence does more than just display data; it actively feeds your pipeline. Once you dial in the perfect search, you can save your filters and share them directly with your team so everyone stays aligned. Even better, you can take immediate action on your findings by pushing data exactly where it belongs:

Send potential leads straight to your Lead Workspace.
Learn more →
Move key Agencies and Vendors directly into your Accounts.
Learn more →
Add crucial connection makers right into your Contacts.
Learn more →
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I find out which government agencies actually buy my specific product?

It is easy to waste time pitching to the wrong department. Our Agencies search allows you to filter by your specific product type and instantly see a list of the exact departments and local offices that have a history of buying it. This helps you build a highly targeted list of prospects so you can focus your outreach where it matters most.

Can I see how much the government usually pays for solutions like mine?

Yes. The Awards search shows you exactly who won previous contracts and the final dollar amount. Seeing these historical numbers gives you a realistic baseline, taking the guesswork out of how to competitively price your own solutions.

How do I know when an existing contract is going to expire so I can prepare to bid?

Timing is everything in government contracting. By using the Contracts search, you can view the scope and expiration dates of current agreements. This allows you to spot upcoming re-competes 12 to 18 months in advance so your team has plenty of time to build a winning strategy before the new solicitation is even announced.

I am a small business. How can researching other vendors help me?

Researching other vendors is one of the fastest ways to get your foot in the door. Instead of just looking at your competition, you can use the Vendors search to identify established prime contractors who frequently win large bids. These larger companies often need capable, specialized small businesses to team up with as subcontractors.

What are contract vehicles and do I need one to win a bid?

Contract vehicles are essentially established purchasing pathways that agencies prefer to use because they save time. Our Vehicles search simplifies this data so you can see exactly which purchasing paths your target agencies use most often. Understanding this helps you position your business perfectly to make a seamless sale or find the right partner who already holds that vehicle.
